an11.5:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā ānando bhikkhu āmantesi …pe…
an11.5:1.2: dussīlassa āvuso sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti avippaṭisāro,
an11.5:1.3: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ.
an11.5:1.4: pāmojje asati pāmojjavipannassa hatūpanisā hoti pīti.
an11.5:1.5: pītiyā asati pītivipannassa hatūpanisā hoti passaddhi.
an11.5:1.6: passaddhiyā asati passaddhi vipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti sukhaṃ.
an11.5:1.7: sukhe asati sukhavipannassa hatūpanisā hoti sammāsamādhi.
an11.5:1.8: sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ.
an11.5:1.9: yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpanisā hoti nibbidā.
an11.5:1.10: nibbidāya asati nibbidāvipannassa hatūpaniso hoti virāgo.
an11.5:1.11: virāge asati virāgavipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an11.5:2.1: seyyathāpi āvuso rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati. tacopi …pe… pheggupi …pe… sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati.
an11.5:2.2: evameva kho āvuso dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti avippaṭisāro.
an11.5:2.3: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ …pe…
an11.5:3.1: sīlavato āvuso sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro.
an11.5:3.2: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ.
an11.5:3.3: pāmojje sati pāmojjasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti pīti.
an11.5:3.4: pītiyā sati pītisampannassa upanisasampannā hoti passaddhi.
an11.5:3.5: passaddhiyā sati passaddhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sukhaṃ.
an11.5:3.6: sukhe sati sukhasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi.
an11.5:3.7: sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ.
an11.5:3.8: yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampannā hoti nibbidā.
an11.5:3.9: nibbidāya sati nibbidāsampannassa upanisasampannā hoti virāgo.
an11.5:3.10: virāge sati virāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
an11.5:4.1: seyyathāpi āvuso rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati. tacopi …pe… pheggupi …pe… sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati.
an11.5:4.2: evameva kho āvuso sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro.
an11.5:4.3: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti pāmojjaṃ …pe…
